text: Fixing #6582/#6589 (ERASE): real VFP9 09.00.0000.7423 on the Windows VM shows an unquoted unparenthesized ERASE operand is a LITERAL filename (ERASE cF erases the file named cF; ERASE (cF) evaluates the variable), function calls still evaluate, and * ? expand case-insensitively (bare, quoted, UDF-returned; *.* too) with no error on no-match. Copperfin evaluated the operand (bare name faulted, wildcards were passed to fs::remove). Also found DELETE FILE was parsed as a record DELETE and never worked. Fail-first: 28 failures before, 0 after. COPY FILE / RENAME (#6583/#6587/#6585/#6586) are the next slice; shared helpers are reusable.
